note: Authors' slip, not a typesetting error; not in the errata lists of EGA II, III or IV. 𝒜 is the ideal of the closed sub-preschema with support f(𝔜) (10.14.1, 10.14.2), so off f(𝔜) it must equal 𝒪_𝔛; with 𝒜 = 0 there, 𝒪_𝔛/𝒜 would be nonzero outside f(𝔜). On U_α − f(𝔜) the sheaf 𝔞_α^Δ already equals 𝒪_𝔛, so the two prescriptions glue on the open cover {U_α, 𝔛 − f(𝔜)}. The corrected edition (r20 current) reads 'égal à 𝒪_𝔛 dans le complémentaire de la réunion des U_α'; the mathematical notes (base1_notes.tex, I, 10) record the point.

note: Authors' slip of the same kind (ideal written for quotient); not in the errata lists. U_α∩f(𝔜) is the support of the quotient (A_α/𝔞_α)^Δ, not of the ideal 𝔞_α^Δ (for 𝔞_α = 0 the ideal has empty support while U_α∩f(𝔜) = U_α).
